content:
Overview

Hermosillo is a city in Sonora with a population of 936,263. Sun-drenched Sonoran capital with a strong manufacturing base and rich culinary traditions. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 290 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
